note: Reference values come from production AGi32 reports (client names removed). Geometry was reconstructed from the report pages. The two NXS reports were made with the WD optic, for which no file is available: the examples use the dli-nxs-wd-approx curve (the real MW file is too narrow for these results). Goal: average within 10 %.
